palette.notes: Not digital pixel art: live-action footage of physical painted wooden cubes (code palette_size 0). Green, red and pale wood paints for a Minecraft watermelon.

lighting: Ordinary indoor video lighting on a desk and a gold stand; no pixel lighting.
silhouette: The finished piece (blocky watermelon slice) is shown up front by the creator; otherwise hands and paint bottles.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 28 changes/s: continuous live footage with quick cuts (about 1.7 s between sheet samples, each a new shot).

texture: Real wood and acrylic paint; 'pixels' are physical cubes.
camera: Handheld/overhead close-ups of hands painting, cut fast; opens on a medium shot of the creator holding the result.
sound: Voice-over message (fundraiser for Palestine) with burned-in captions.

acting.enters: Creator appears first holding the finished piece (payoff first), then the video becomes hands-only process.
acting.acts: Hands paint cubes one colour at a time while the voice-over carries the message.
acting.exits: Creator leaves the frame after the opener; only hands remain.
acting.depth: Close-ups only after the opener; no depth staging.

techniques: not pixel art: physical craft of painted cubes
show the finished result first, then the process
voice-over + burned-in captions over a process montage
fast cuts every shot sample (about 1.7 s)
feel: not pixel art; result-first hook + fast hands-only craft montage + VO captions = message carried by a process video
for_fred: Only the structure transfers: show the finished pixel scene with Fred in the first second, then build it up. Nothing for Fred's look or acting.
